notes: Company background: mid-market SaaS (B2B customer service platform) with ~350 employees. Integrates with Zendesk and internal CRM.
Primary objective: replace brittle rule-based macros with streaming LLM agent that can call internal tools (ticket lookup, customer profile, KB search).
Latency requirement: strict — product PM quoted target: <1.5s first-token 95th percentile for US region. Will need streaming + low cold-starts.
Throughput/Scale: ~80 concurrent agent sessions during peak; average 12 requests/sec sustained for the cluster. Cost sensitive — wants clear per-token + per-stream pricing.
POC scope: 2-week hosted POC. Tests: 1) streaming first-token SLO, 2) tool-calling reliability (mock ticket API), 3) fallback policy under throttling, 4) prefix caching behavior.
Quote from product lead: 'We need the agent to feel instantaneous — anything over ~1.5s and CSAT drops.'
Security: must pass SAML SSO, audit log visibility for all API calls, optional EU residency for certain customers. KMS for key management requested.
Migration plan: start on Hosted API for speed, after stable SLOs evaluate Dedicated for committed capacity and predictable TCO. Interested in Dedicated autoscaling + burst options.
POC logistics: will provide anonymized logs and synthetic traffic profile; SE to provide POC test harness (Leo).
Pricing convo: discussed mid-market committed seat pricing vs usage; client asked for example ARR with X concurrent chats — follow up to model numbers.
Support expectations: want 24h response for incidents during POC, and clear escalation path for SLA misses. Asked about automatic fallback to smaller model under throttling.
